title: Molecular orbitals of hydrogen
caption: Two 1s orbitals combine into a lower-energy bonding σ1s and a higher-energy antibonding σ*1s. H₂'s two electrons pair in σ1s: bond order 1. In He₂ the extra two would fill σ*1s and cancel the bond, which is why He₂ does not exist.
alt: MO diagram: 1s on each hydrogen; σ1s below with two paired electrons, σ*1s above and empty.
description: Each H atom: one electron in 1s.
